unchanged_scope_criteria:
**Retain:** the existing Royalty790 lower construction and separately retained full-frame source; neither is a completed suite. The target remains 50 Deluxe, 25 Premium, five Royalty and one Supreme as replacements within 1,000 units. All 81 on D17 remains a proposal. The 2,000-passenger admission cap is distinct from physical sleeping capacity.

**Still required:** complete multistorey Royalty/Supreme interiors, stairs/private accessible vertical travel, kitchens, viewing/conversation spaces, enclosure and services; habitat adaptation and final unit/berth mapping. Retain shared VIP secondary pools, lounge/bar, private dining and forward/aft observation, plus family nursery/children's centre, play/learning, garden/hydroponic lounge, adult rest/sightlines, meditation and residential observation nooks. Resolve these within existing programmes without duplicate venues. Shared VIP pool count, location and access remain unresolved; private baths do not fulfil that requirement.

Evidence: [design contract](../data/design_contract.json), [D17 luxury study](D17_LUXURY_HOUSE_STUDY.md), [Royalty frame progress](D17_ROYALTY_FRAME_SOURCE_PROGRESS.json) and [VIP amenity section review](architecture_packages/vip_amenities/VIP_AMENITY_SECTION_REVIEW.md).
